reason: Batch 003 source audit removed unsupported parking-structure geometry locators. PD 1096 Rule VII supports slot/loading sizes and plan indication; BP 344 supports accessible parking details. Rule XIX, Section 803, and Section 904 are not parking geometry locators.

proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VII, what is the source-backed parking/loading slot size for a standard truck or bus?
proposed.rationale: PD 1096 Rule VII supports 3.60 m x 12.00 m for standard truck or bus parking/loading slots.
proposed.explanation: The old module-width question was not locally source-supported.
